desc: You cannot walk alone in the darkness.
name: Ariel

1.desc:
<color=#FFFFFF>Active Skill</color>
Flies high into the air, then blinks to the target's vicinity, attacking and pulling in enemies across a large area. After a short time, a Prismatic Cross is generated that deals <color=#FE437E>Ether DMG</color>. Once the pull ends, gain 1/2/3 random buffs based on the number of enemies pulled (the same buff cannot be gained more than once):
Buff 1: Restore the Agent's HP.
Buff 2: Restore the Agent's Energy.
Buff 3: Increase Prismatic Cross DMG.
1.name: Searing Flash
